subject: Request: Community credits pilot for OpenCanvas maintainers
messages:
From: Linus Park <linus@opencanvas.org>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah@ossfund.org>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Community credits pilot for OpenCanvas maintainers

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well — I’m Linus, one of the lead maintainers at OpenCanvas (MIT-licensed creative tools for the web). We run a small cohort of core maintainers who rely on CI, image-generation bots, and occasional model-assisted content moderation for our contributor workflow.

We saw Redwood’s community credits program and would love to run a short pilot so our maintainers can migrate some CI jobs and bot integrations off their personal accounts. Rough ask: 3 months of coverage for 3 maintainers, estimated 400–600k tokens/month total (mostly generation for testing and CI). Use cases: automated changelog generation, PR test artifacts, and a moderation pipeline for community uploads.

Attaching a roster (maintainers_list.csv) and a short note on expected usage. Happy to share a mutual action plan if you want to trial this as a named pilot. We’re community-run and can include a short case study on the OpenCanvas blog.

Thanks — let me know what info you need.

— Linus
Linus Park
OpenCanvas lead maintainer
https://github.com/opencanvas
attachments: maintainers_list.csv (csv)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Linus Park <linus@opencanvas.org>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Community credits pilot for OpenCanvas maintainers

Hi Linus — thanks for the note and the roster, appreciate the context.

Quick ask from our side so we can process this through the PLG community credits flow:
- Confirm the canonical GitHub org/repo you want the credits linked to (link in your message is fine).
- Confirm the exact recipient emails for the 3 maintainers (we need these to provision per-account credits).
- Estimated monthly token spend (you mentioned 400–600k — if you can give a point estimate that helps).
- Any required compliance notes (e.g., data retention preferences) or red flags.

We have a self-serve issuance path in the Redwood Console for approved community projects — once approvals are in, I can issue a promo code or directly provision credits to the listed emails. I’ll loop in Dev (our community credits lead) for final sign-off.

If it helps, we can also do a short 30-minute sync this week.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Developer Partnerships (Community Programs)
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 10:27:00 -0700

Thanks for routing, Rachel. I reviewed the roster and usage notes. Approve a small pilot under the community credits program.

Approval details (internal):
- Pilot size: $3,000 USD equivalent (approx 150k tokens/month) applied per maintainer across 3 months (total USD value $9,000).
- Redemption method: issue per-email promotional credit in Console OR generate one-time promo codes for each recipient. I recommend per-email provisioning for easier tracking.
- Terms: 3-month duration, single renewal possible after usage review. Legal to review standard OSS pilot terms — attaching template (oss-pilot-terms.docx).

Rachel — please provision credits for: linus@opencanvas.org, meera@opencanvas.org, grant@opencanvas.org. Please confirm expiration (suggested: 2026-11-18) and whether we set hard quota or soft alerts.

CC’ing Grace for ops visibility.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Manager, Community Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: Credits issued: OpenCanvas community pilot (redwood promo codes)

Hi Linus / Meera / Grant — great to connect. Per our internal approval, I’ve provisioned community pilot credits for each of the three maintainers named below. Details and next steps: 

Provisioning summary:
- Each recipient: $1,000 USD equivalent in Redwood credits (redeemable via the Redwood Console)
- Duration: 3 months from activation (expires 2026-11-18 if not activated)
- How to redeem: Visit https://console.redwood.com/promo/activate and paste the code for your email. If you’re logged in with a different email, please redeem and then open a support ticket to remap.

Codes (one per recipient):
- linus@opencanvas.org — PROMO-OC-2026-LINUS-001
- meera@opencanvas.org — PROMO-OC-2026-MEERA-002
- grant@opencanvas.org — PROMO-OC-2026-GRANT-003

Notes:
- We set a soft quota alert at 80% usage so we can evaluate for renewal.
- Attached: credits_issuance_record.pdf (internal audit), quickstart guide for maintainers (link below).
- If you want per-repo restrictions or IP restrictions for the keys, file a request with support@redwood.com and we’ll route to Private deployments team.

Helpful links: https://console.redwood.com/promo/activate | Quickstart: https://docs.redwood.com/community/credits-quickstart

If anything needs adjustment (redeem failures, wrong emails), reply here and I’ll loop in ops. Looking forward to seeing how the maintainers use this.

Best,
Rachel Kim
